name: Glimpse
title: Glimpse
description: Asks Elorian's Glimpse a question about a video or images
whenToUse: Watch a video or look at images and answer a question about them: what happens and when, what people are doing, whether a picture matches its caption. Reasons over the frames themselves, reading motion, posture, timing and layout, and hears the clip's speech too, so the answer cites moments by timestamp. One video and up to 20 images per question, each given as a link.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: Data from previous nodes that can be referenced in templates

outputs.name: usage
outputs.description: Tokens spent, cached tokens, and what the model saw (usage.elorian frames, fps, video seconds, images)

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that answers. Glimpse is the agent model that runs code and searches on its own.

reasoningEffort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: How long the model thinks before answering. Extra High is the most thorough and the slowest.

maxTokens.title: Max Output Tokens
maxTokens.description: Caps the answer, and the model's hidden thinking spends from it too: too low and the answer comes back empty. Elorian recommends 8,000; your tier may cap it lower.

videoFps.title: Video Frames per Second
videoFps.description: How many frames a second the model sees. Lower it for a long clip that will not fit.

videoUrl.title: Video
videoUrl.description: One clip, as an https link (MP4, MOV or WebM) or file://<id> for a file uploaded to Elorian. Optional.

imageUrls.title: Images
imageUrls.description: Up to 20 images, each an https link or a data URL (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF). Optional.

systemPrompt.title: Instructions
systemPrompt.description: Standing instructions for every run. Shared blocks work here, e.g. {{prompt.markdownGuidelines}}.

prompt.title: Question
prompt.description: What to ask about the video or images. Usually wired in from an upstream node.

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: elorian
package.packageFile:
# Elorian, fully declarative.
#
# Glimpse is OpenAI-COMPATIBLE chat completions (platform.elorian.ai docs: "a developer who has used
# OpenAI's API changes two lines"), so this package is the zai one without its tool loop: the agent
# model runs its own hosted tools and refuses function tools (undefined_tool_called).

name: elorian
displayName: Elorian
description: Glimpse, Elorian's visual reasoning model, over images and video
version: 1.0.0
category: ai

features:
  - Answers questions about one video and up to 20 images, citing moments by timestamp

allowedHosts:
  - api.elorian.ai

requires:
  credential: [bearer]
  transport: [json]

credentials.elorianCredential.yaml:
name: elorianCredential
displayName: Elorian API
description: API key for Elorian (Glimpse). Requests are paid from credits from the first token.
documentationUrl: https://platform.elorian.ai/settings/docs

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Created in the Elorian console under API keys
    placeholder: elor_sk_...

files.api/events.yaml:
# ONE ROW PER OUTPUT CONNECTOR, in interface.yaml order.

- emit: text
  value: "return (((response.choices || [])[0] || {}).message || {}).content || ''"

- emit: usage
  value: "return response.usage"
files.api/run.yaml:
# Elorian's chat-completions endpoint. NO SDK.
#
# The user message is a list of content parts: the question, then each image, then the video. Video
# is a part shaped like image_url, one per request. video_fps is an Elorian field, sent beside the
# OpenAI ones. Built with `concat`, never `push`: the sandbox has no mutating array methods.

- name: generate
  method: POST
  url: https://api.elorian.ai/v1/chat/completions

  credential:
    scheme: bearer
    token: "{{ credentials.elorianCredential.apiKey }}"

  body: |
    return (() => {
      const images = (Array.isArray(config.imageUrls) ? config.imageUrls : [])
        .filter(url => typeof url === 'string' && url.trim())
        .map(url => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: url.trim() } }));
      const video = config.videoUrl && config.videoUrl.trim()
        ? [{ type: 'video_url', video_url: { url: config.videoUrl.trim() } }]
        : [];
      const head = config.systemPrompt ? [{ role: 'system', content: config.systemPrompt }] : [];
      const content = [{ type: 'text', text: config.prompt }].concat(images, video);
      return Object.assign({
        model: config.model,
        max_completion_tokens: config.maxTokens || 8000,
        reasoning_effort: config.reasoningEffort || 'xhigh',
        messages: head.concat([{ role: 'user', content: content }])
      }, video.length ? { video_fps: config.videoFps || 2 } : {});
    })()

  # Agent runs can take minutes, and nothing comes back until the run ends.
  timeoutMs: 900000

  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 520, 522, 524]

  # Unstreamed, the connection is kept open with blank lines until the run ends, which JSON ignores.
  transport: json

  # An answer that fails after those blank lines is a 200 carrying {"error": {...}}.
  error:
    when: "return !!response.error"
    message: "return response.error.message || 'Glimpse request failed'"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [model, prompt]
  properties:
    model:
      type: string
      title: Model
      description: The model that answers. Glimpse is the agent model that runs code and searches on its own.
      enum: [elorian-1-agent]
      enumNames: ["Glimpse (elorian-1-agent)"]
      default: elorian-1-agent
    reasoningEffort:
      type: string
      title: Reasoning Effort
      description: How long the model thinks before answering. Extra High is the most thorough and the slowest.
      enum: [low, medium, xhigh]
      enumNames: [Low, Medium, Extra High]
      default: xhigh
    maxTokens:
      type: number
      title: Max Output Tokens
      description: >-
        Caps the answer, and the model's hidden thinking spends from it too: too low and the answer
        comes back empty. Elorian recommends 8,000; your tier may cap it lower.
      default: 8000
      minimum: 1
    videoFps:
      type: number
      title: Video Frames per Second
      description: How many frames a second the model sees. Lower it for a long clip that will not fit.
      default: 2
      minimum: 0.1
      maximum: 15
    videoUrl:
      type: string
      title: Video
      description: >-
        One clip, as an https link (MP4, MOV or WebM) or file://<id> for a file uploaded to Elorian.
        Optional.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    imageUrls:
      type: array
      title: Images
      description: Up to 20 images, each an https link or a data URL (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF). Optional.
      items:
        type: string
      default: []
      "ui:field": template
    systemPrompt:
      type: string
      title: Instructions
      description: Standing instructions for every run. Shared blocks work here, e.g. {{prompt.markdownGuidelines}}.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    prompt:
      type: string
      title: Question
      description: What to ask about the video or images. Usually wired in from an upstream node.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
"ui:order":
  [model, reasoningEffort, maxTokens, videoFps, videoUrl, imageUrls, systemPrompt, prompt]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: signal
    type: object
    description: Data from previous nodes that can be referenced in templates
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: text
    type: string
    description: The answer
  - name: usage
    type: object
    description: Tokens spent, cached tokens, and what the model saw (usage.elorian frames, fps, video seconds, images)

credentials:
  - name: elorianCredential
    required: true
    displayName: Elorian API
files.node.yaml:
type: Glimpse
# A PromiseNode: one request, one answer. Not streamed, because a Chat Completions chunk carries no event
# `type` and lint accepts an untyped stream only on a node with a tool loop, which Glimpse has none of.
# Unstreamed, Elorian holds the connection open until the run ends and answers with one JSON body.
kind: PromiseNode

name: Glimpse
category: AI
color: "#1f2a44"

description: Asks Elorian's Glimpse a question about a video or images

whenToUse: >-
  Watch a video or look at images and answer a question about them: what happens and when, what
  people are doing, whether a picture matches its caption. Reasons over the frames themselves,
  reading motion, posture, timing and layout, and hears the clip's speech too, so the answer cites
  moments by timestamp. One video and up to 20 images per question, each given as a link.

auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # The agent searches the web and runs code on its own, so the same question can take a different
  # path on every run.
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
# Running it live needs ELORIAN_API_KEY (credential `elorianCredential`), on an account with credits.
# The clip is the one on elorian.ai/models: a seven-second pencil sketch, no audio, no caption.

testData:
  config:
    model: elorian-1-agent
    reasoningEffort: medium
    maxTokens: 4000
    videoFps: 5
    videoUrl: https://elorian.ai/assets/models/glimpse-dance.mp4
    imageUrls: []
    systemPrompt: Answer in Markdown. Cite moments in the clip by their time range.
    prompt: What kind of dance are the characters doing, and how does it change over the clip?
  inputs:
    signal:
      topic: dance identification
  expect:
    text: "return typeof output.text === 'string' && output.text.length > 0"
    usage: "return output.usage.completion_tokens > 0"
